description: An MP's or peer's declared financial interests by category: outside jobs and earnings, donations, gifts and hospitality, overseas visits, shareholdings and more, with payment details and registration dates, from the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "who pays or funds my MP?" for constituents, journalists and due diligence. Shows what members declared, unverified; ministers' interests published by the Cabinet Office are not included. (cost: 1 credit)

memberId.description: integer, required, Parliament member id (from mp_lookup or constituency_search), e.g. 172

name: member_registered_interests
